articles.title: Tailscale Traces Database Corruption to 16y/o SQLite WAL-Reset Bug
articles.author: ropbear

zh.thesis: Tailscale追踪到SQLite中一个16年历史的罕见数据竞争错误。
points: 手动控制检查点导致更频繁触发错误。
错误导致写入事务在检查点期间丢失页面。
修复已发布，但需谨慎部署以避免其他回归问题。

en.thesis: Tailscale traces a database corruption to a 16-year-old rare data race bug in SQLite.
points: Manual checkpoint control triggers the bug more frequently.
The bug loses write transactions during checkpointing.
A fix is released, but deployment requires caution to avoid regressions.

articles.title: License plate reader searches should require a warrant
articles.author: apwheele

zh.thesis: 车牌识别历史数据搜索应需搜查令，而非删除数据。
points: 删除数据并不能防止滥用，反而妨碍合法侦查。
未来摄像头将无处不在，法律迟早要求搜查令。
建议设立明确惩罚和第三方审计，而非依赖数据留存。

en.thesis: License plate reader historical searches should require warrants, not data deletion.
points: Deleting data doesn't prevent abuse and hinders legitimate investigations.
Future cameras will be everywhere, and warrants will be legally required.
Proposes clear penalties and third-party audits rather than data retention.

articles.title: Roundup #86: Unintended consequences
articles.author: Noah Smith

zh.thesis: 本周合集揭示政策与技术的意外后果，从MAGA衰退到AI促进外包。
points: MAGA影响力下降，因未建立持久机构。
劳动份额下降部分源于税收分类和股票薪酬，未必真实。
AI尚未提升生产率，但投资本身带来宏观增长。

en.thesis: This week's roundup reveals unintended consequences of policy and tech, from MAGA decline to AI promoting outsourcing.
points: MAGA influence wanes due to lack of lasting institutions.
Declining labor share partly stems from tax classification and stock compensation, possibly not real.
AI hasn't boosted productivity yet, but investment itself yields macro growth.

articles.title: AI is removing the middle class of software engineering?
articles.author: florianherrengt

zh.thesis: AI让平庸工程师能制造大量技术债，正在淘汰中间层。
points: AI提高了代码产出速度，但审阅和理解能力没有跟上。
糟糕的工程师现在能更快地积累复杂性和债务。
判断力成为最稀缺的技能，优秀工程师更值钱。

en.thesis: AI lets mediocre engineers generate massive technical debt, eroding the middle class of software engineering.
points: AI boosts code output speed, but review and comprehension lag behind.
Poor engineers now accumulate complexity and debt faster.
Judgment becomes the scarcest skill, making good engineers more valuable.

articles.title: AI Agents: Architecture

zh.thesis: AI代理架构需拆分为多个步骤，而非依赖单一强大模型。
points: 单一模型调用在成本、可见性和优化上不如拆分。
分类、提取等简单任务用小型模型可降低成本。
工具循环中使用前沿模型驱动，但预算检查用代码确保准确性。

en.thesis: AI agent architecture should split into multiple steps rather than rely on a single powerful model.
points: Single model calls are less cost-effective, less observable, and harder to optimize than splitting.
Use small models for simple tasks like classification and extraction to cut costs.
Use frontier models for the tool loop, but code-based budget checks ensure accuracy.

articles.title: Abdul El-Sayed can win moderate voters
articles.author: Matthew Yglesias

zh.thesis: El-Sayed能以温和派身份赢得密歇根州参议院选举。
points: 左翼身份可通过聚焦国内问题赢得温和选民。
在以色列和医保上采取务实现实路径。
避免成为派系工具，与党内团结合作至关重要。

en.thesis: El-Sayed can win Michigan's Senate race by positioning as a moderate.
points: Leftist identity can win moderates by focusing on domestic issues.
He takes pragmatic paths on Israel and healthcare.
Avoiding being a factional tool and cooperating with party unity is crucial.

articles.title: Mistakes in financial economics
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 声称AI将毁灭世界的人应买入看跌期权，否则暴露其真实信念。
points: 买深度价外看跌期权成本低，可对冲末日风险。
拒绝下单暴露了内心其实不认为AI会那么糟。
长期持仓容易，做空或对冲才真正暴露信念。

en.thesis: Those claiming AI will destroy the world should buy put options, or their true beliefs are exposed.
points: Deep out-of-the-money puts are cheap and hedge against doomsday risk.
Refusing to place the order reveals they don't actually think AI is that bad.
Holding long is easy; shorting or hedging truly reveals conviction.

articles.title: What makes people happy?
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 俄罗斯人生活满意度在入侵乌克兰后上升，表明战时民族融合。
points: 幸福感增加在军事工业区更大，靠近前线更小。
这种差异模式难以用社会期望偏差解释。
到2024年，数据缺失增加，指标信息价值下降。

en.thesis: Russians' life satisfaction rose after invading Ukraine, indicating wartime national cohesion.
points: Happiness gains are larger in military-industrial zones and smaller near the front.
This pattern is hard to explain away by social desirability bias.
By 2024, missing data increases, reducing the indicator's informational value.

articles.title: Why tiny JPEGs look different in Chrome
articles.author: gutechh

zh.thesis: Chrome对小型JPEG的优化导致渲染差异，源于部分解码。
points: Chrome使用部分IDCT缩放，跳过高频数据。
在1/8缩放以下，只保留恒定分量，导致图像更粗。
JPEG格式不适合图标，建议使用SVG或PNG。

en.thesis: Chrome's optimization for small JPEGs causes rendering differences due to partial decoding.
points: Chrome uses partial IDCT scaling, skipping high-frequency data.
Below 1/8 scaling, it keeps only constant components, making images coarser.
JPEG isn't suited for icons; use SVG or PNG instead.

articles.title: Immigrant Earnings Assimilation, 1981–2021
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 美国移民收入同化加速，但回流移民表现较差。
points: 20%-33%的移民在10年内回流。
1990年代中期后的永久移民收入在10年内与本地人趋同。
回流移民起始收入类似但增长缓慢。

en.thesis: U.S. immigrant earnings assimilation has accelerated, but return migrants perform worse.
points: 20-33% of immigrants return within 10 years.
Permanent immigrants post-mid-1990s converge to native earnings within 10 years.
Return migrants start similarly but grow more slowly.

articles.title: I Deleted My Calendar Link. And I’m Never Going Back
articles.author: JA Westenberg

zh.thesis: 删除日历链接，主动拥抱摩擦，以夺回对时间的掌控。
points: 日历链接把稀缺时间变成无限自助购物，鼓励自私占用。
大多数会议本身低效，链接只是让更多无意义会议发生。
拒绝摩擦是一种筛选，让真正重要的会面自然浮现。

en.thesis: Deleting my calendar link, I embrace friction to take back control of my time.
points: Calendar links turn scarce time into endless self-service shopping, encouraging selfish occupancy.
Most meetings are ineffective anyway; links just enable more meaningless ones.
Friction is a filter that lets truly important meetings emerge naturally.

articles.title: Google's AI found a Chrome bug hiding for 13 years, and it's only getting faster
articles.author: Rich Edmonds

zh.thesis: Google用AI修复Chrome漏洞效率大增，但引出补丁分发与攻防新问题。
points: AI修补的漏洞数超过前23个版本总和，共1072个。
AI找到在Chrome中潜藏13年的旧漏洞，速度在加快。
漏洞公开到修复推送存在窗口期，攻击者可趁机利用。

en.thesis: Google uses AI to fix Chrome vulnerabilities far faster, but it raises new issues in patch distribution and attacks.
points: AI fixed more bugs than the previous 23 versions combined, totaling 1,072.
AI found a 13-year-old Chrome bug, and its speed is increasing.
There's a window between public disclosure and patch rollout that attackers can exploit.

articles.title: Base Power Company: Chapter 3
articles.author: Packy McCormick

zh.thesis: Base Power估值达130亿美元，目标是成为世界最大能源公司。
points: 公司不到三年，成为第二有价值的能源初创。
取消Gen 2，加速自研制造Gen 3电池。
战略是抓住电网瓶颈，垂直整合，并扩展到AI基础设施。

en.thesis: Base Power is valued at $13B, aiming to become the world's largest energy company.
points: Under three years, it's the second most valuable energy startup.
Cancels Gen 2 to accelerate in-house Gen 3 battery manufacturing.
Strategy targets grid bottlenecks, vertical integration, and expansion into AI infrastructure.

articles.title: Grok 4.6
articles.author: iLuddite

zh.thesis: Grok 4.6发布，聚焦长时运行代理与交互视觉工作。
points: 在多个代理编码与知识工作基准上达到前沿水平。
匹配GPT-5.6 Sol的智能指数，部分基准超过。
定价不变，每百万输入2美元、输出6美元。

en.thesis: Grok 4.6 launches, focusing on long-running agents and interactive visual work.
points: It reaches frontier performance on several agentic coding and knowledge benchmarks.
Matches GPT-5.6 Sol's intelligence index, and beats it on some benchmarks.
Pricing unchanged at $2/M input and $6/M output.

articles.title: Delta
articles.author: khy

zh.thesis: Zed推出Delta，一个以对话为中心的多人协作编码环境。
points: Delta将代码与对话实时同步，评论锚定在代码行。
通过DeltaDB实现工作树级协作，支持云端运行。
重点服务AI代理开发，界面针对长文本和高频输出优化。

en.thesis: Zed launches Delta, a collaborative coding environment centered on conversation.
points: Delta syncs code and chat in real time, anchoring comments to code lines.
It uses DeltaDB for workspace-level collaboration and cloud execution.
It targets AI agent development, with UI optimized for long text and high-frequency output.

articles.title: Ep. #10, The System Is More Than the Code with Charity Majors
articles.author: Heavybit

zh.thesis: Charity Majors认为代码变得可抛弃，但系统架构和运行行为才是持久资产。
points: 可观测性使生产成为最终真相来源。
AI改变软件经济学，但系统复杂性仍需要人类判断。
负责任使用AI意味着理解其在不可预测系统中的角色。

en.thesis: Charity Majors argues code becomes disposable, but system architecture and runtime behavior are the durable assets.
points: Observability makes production the ultimate source of truth.
AI changes software economics, but system complexity still needs human judgment.
Responsible AI use means understanding its role in unpredictable systems.

articles.title: I can't believe how good this AI coding model is, and it isn't from OpenAI or Anthropic
articles.author: Parth Shah

zh.thesis: Grok 4.5在编码中效率出众，但复杂任务仍依赖其他模型。
points: Grok 4.5用约40k tokens完成网站构建，效率惊人。
对简单修改响应直接，不浪费上下文。
复杂问题仍切换至Claude Code，可能是Grok 4.6的改进方向。

en.thesis: Grok 4.5 is impressively efficient in coding, but complex tasks still rely on other models.
points: Grok 4.5 builds a website with about 40k tokens, showing surprising efficiency.
It responds directly to simple changes without wasting context.
For complex problems, it switches to Claude Code, likely a focus for Grok 4.6 improvements.

articles.title: Someone is running mass vulnerability scans, spoofing AI bots like ClaudeBot
articles.author: gavinhking

zh.thesis: 网络流量中，AI代理和爬虫占比上升，但有人冒名进行漏洞扫描。
points: AI相关流量占机器人流量的28%，比上季度增长11%。
ClaudeBot是最大的AI数据抓取代理，占27%。
robots.txt遵守率高达98.5%，但部分机器人违反。

en.thesis: AI agents and crawlers are a growing share of web traffic, but some are spoofed for vulnerability scanning.
points: AI-related traffic is 28% of bot traffic, up 11% from last quarter.
ClaudeBot is the largest AI data scraper at 27%.
robots.txt compliance is high at 98.5%, but some bots violate it.

articles.title: Grok 4.6 scores 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
articles.author: wertyk

zh.thesis: Grok 4.6在智能指数登顶，性能与成本兼优。
points: Grok 4.6得分61，与GPT-5.6 Sol持平，落后于Claude Opus 5。
代理任务表现突出，尤其在银行客服和终端任务上。
定价低于竞争模型，任务成本仅0.84美元。

en.thesis: Grok 4.6 tops the intelligence index, excelling in performance and cost.
points: Grok 4.6 scores 61, tied with GPT-5.6 Sol but behind Claude Opus 5.
It excels in agentic tasks, especially banking support and terminal tasks.
Priced lower than rivals, with task cost only $0.84.

articles.title: Tim King, AmigaDOS developer, has died
articles.author: doener

zh.thesis: AmigaDOS开发者蒂姆·金去世。
points: 金是Tripos操作系统的主要作者，后成为AmigaDOS。
他后来创立了Perihelion和UK Online。
对Amiga软件历史有重要贡献。

en.thesis: Tim King, developer of AmigaDOS, has passed away.
points: King was the primary author of Tripos, which became AmigaDOS.
He later founded Perihelion and UK Online.
He made significant contributions to Amiga software history.

articles.title: uBlock Origin Is Giving Up the Fight to Keep Ads Off Facebook
articles.author: Markoff

zh.thesis: uBlock Origin停止尝试屏蔽Facebook广告。
points: Facebook广告越来越难屏蔽。
该决定是社区讨论后做出的。

en.thesis: uBlock Origin stops attempting to block ads on Facebook.
points: Facebook ads have become increasingly difficult to block.
The decision came after community discussions.

articles.title: New York is building. But where?
articles.author: Halina Bennet

zh.thesis: 纽约豪宅税被法院叫停，报道事件本身。
points: 史坦顿岛法官暂停了豪宅税的实施。
该税针对高价值第二套住宅的房主。
文章大部分内容被付费墙遮挡，细节有限。

en.thesis: A Staten Island judge paused New York's luxury tax, halting its implementation.
points: The judge temporarily halted the tax's enforcement.
The tax targets owners of high-value second homes.
Most of the article is behind a paywall, so details are limited.

articles.title: Wednesday assorted links
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 一系列互不相关的链接合集，缺乏深入论证。
points: 意大利银行的奶酪抵押品正在融化。
丹麦一半的经济增长来自一家公司。
美国消费者在外国旅行上的支出占比低于中国进口商品。

en.thesis: A collection of unrelated links lacking deep argumentation.
points: Italian banks' cheese collateral is melting.
Denmark's half of economic growth comes from one company.
U.S. consumer spending on foreign travel is lower than on Chinese imports.

articles.title: Qwen3.8-2.4T
articles.author: Philpax

zh.thesis: 开源模型Qwen3.8-2.4T发布，参数规模巨大。
points: 总参数2.4万亿，激活950亿。
在SWE Bench Pro上得分67.7，GPQA Diamond 92.6。
支持工具调用，提供多种推理强度控制。

en.thesis: Open-source model Qwen3.8-2.4T launches with massive parameter scale.
points: Total parameters at 2.4T with 95B active.
Scores 67.7 on SWE Bench Pro and 92.6 on GPQA Diamond.
Supports tool calling and offers multiple reasoning intensity controls.

articles.title: Fast Company covers New Aesthetics
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 《Fast Company》报道了新美学，作者称赞该报道。
points: 文章提到艺术家成为故事的核心。
内容仅此而已，缺乏深入分析。

en.thesis: Fast Company covers New Aesthetics, and the author praises the report.
points: The article highlights artists at the core of the story.
That's all; it lacks deep analysis.

articles.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
articles.author: explosion-s

zh.thesis: 仅标题，无法总结内容。
points: 标题提到DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813。
没有正文可供分析。

en.thesis: Title only; content cannot be summarized.
points: The title mentions DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813.
No body text to analyze.

articles.title: 2026 Eclipse Webcams
articles.author: zoenolan

zh.thesis: 标题提及2026年日食网络摄像头。
points: 仅标题，无法总结。

en.thesis: Title mentions 2026 eclipse webcams.
points: Title only; cannot summarize.
